name: test_prod_never_allows_application_creation_or_live_email
description:
Objective: Production disables application creation and refuses live email.
Preconditions: Repository dependencies are installed; execute in the deterministic lane with no deployed-service or customer-data dependency.
Steps:
1. Run the case in the repository deterministic lane with the deployed browser/service fixtures disabled.
2. Import config.settings with ALLOW_SHARED_APPLICATION_CREATION=true, then with RUN_EXTERNAL_DELIVERY_TESTS=true.
Expected: 1. Creation is forced off; enabling live email aborts the import.
